steps.name: Regards (1)
steps.objective: After talking to “Parmilla” at “Oscuras Mercenary Camp”, obtain <Hawa’s Toy> from “The Sky Castle” and report it to [Belita] at “Drullage”.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s, I'd like to lend you a hand, is it possible?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: No big deal, remember Belita from Drullizi?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. A girl holding baby lions.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I see you remember. thank god.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Fortunately... That's nice, but what's going on?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Belita is looking for toys for her baby lions, but it looks like she can't find anything suitable.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: As a child growing up, most toys get messy right away, so I think I want something a little more durable.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Our mercenary group can quickly make dog and cat toys, but I think it will be a bit difficult to make toys for lions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, do they make something like that?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Sometimes I put on doll eyes too.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: So, anything comes to mind?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can’t remember anything in particular… . ah!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: There's something!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go get it. Wait, I don't think I can finish with just one. How many should I bring?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I think five would be plenty. Once you get it, go straight to Drulidge, okay? And the request fee is collected from Belita.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. See you later then.

steps.name: Regards (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Rosemary] in “Eastern Border of Jude Kingdom”.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: It's been a while. I guess you've been busy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, something happened. I brought the baby lion toy you requested from the mercenaries.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: Thank you. I think this is my first time seeing such a hard toy.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: Looking closely, it looks like someone gave it as a gift to someone they care about... . Can I accept something this precious?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Because ‘he’ has many things like this.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: Who is he?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing. Anyway, see you next time.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: You have to collect the request fee.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmilla told me to collect the request fee, but it's not something that's difficult to obtain, so I don't really want to accept it.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: Hmm… . Then I feel sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Then I will go.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: Where are you going?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I'll have to work near Luman in Eastland for a while, so I'm going to Luman.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: If you see Rosemary or Frozen on your way, would you please say hello?

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: I don't know exactly where you are, but I heard that you are on the Eastern Continent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know those two?

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: In the past, Demigod Frozen stayed in the village with Rosemary for a while.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: There was a brief difficulty in the village, but thanks to the two of you, we were able to get through it without incident.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: Rivera's evil mayor, Jekal, had messed up the mushroom forest before he took office. They said that mushrooms in the forest could make money, so they picked mushrooms and fruits indiscriminately.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: Since ancient times, the nature and resources of the Mirgandia region have had special power. Mushrooms also have that special feeling.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: Because we collect so many mushrooms, part of the forest is bound to die.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, so the power of the forest has returned thanks to Demigod Frozen's help.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: Yes, that's right. It's not as perfect as it used to be, but I'm still able to maintain my current form.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard the story well. Then I will say hello to Rosemary. Because you are still in Jude Kingdom.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: However, I don't know where Demigod Frozen is.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: It's unfortunate, but there's nothing we can do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, I'll ask just in case. Then I'll go. I'm doing great.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: Thank you. Please come to Drullizi again later. Did you know?

steps.name: Regards (3)
steps.objective: Obtain the <Fragment of the Demon World> from the "Romance of Hell" and report it to [Rosemary] in the "Eastern Border of Jude Kingdom".

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Wow, you are the hero of Jude Kingdom.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, please don't call me that.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Why? It's true that Jude saved the kingdom.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: But what's going on here? I already heard that you are busy after meeting Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you come here for... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I will briefly explain what happened so far and how I got here.)

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Hmm… , I see.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Belita, that pretty girl remembers me. It feels good! I don't know when I'll see you again.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: (Rosemary shows a happy expression that is not usually seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know any news about Frozen?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Oh, that human? It’s been a while since I’ve been to the North Sea. maybe… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Last time I only heard about the North Sea. Where exactly is it?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I don't know either. I only know of it near the ice-filled beach in the northernmost part of this eastern continent. Probably near the Deborah area.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I know that Belita cares about that person, but that person is not an ordinary human and would probably get along well alone, right?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: No news is good news. Wait, something feels strange.

lines.speaker: 메이스
lines.text: Rosemary, are you there? When I went to Luman, I found a letter from Rosemary and brought it with me.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Good job. But who told me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you writing to, why do you look at me like that?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: It's that human. The timing is amazing. What can I say, it looks like that person has something to say to the hero of Jude Kingdom.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Because it is also a human ability to induce this kind of timing... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Frozen?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: It looks like that person has a favor to ask you. Iris What about your name %s When I see it written down, you have to listen to it whether you like it or not, right?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Huh? There's a device on the back of this thing. I think I need to bring a certain item to decipher it.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Phew, I guess I'll have to try that human rhythm once.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's about Iris, there's nothing you can do about it. So what do I have to do?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Bring two items called [Fragments of the Demon World]. Just hearing the name sounds ominous. I want to go with you, but they say only you can get that item... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be helped. Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Yeah. okay.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: By the way, what was Frozen's idea of sealing the letter with something from the demon world?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I think the time has come... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I went there. I also got some stuff.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: This is that thing... , it’s creepy just to look at it. It's been a long time since an object contained the energy of the demon world... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how do you decode it?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: You seem to think I only fight, but even though it looks like this, I am from the Temple of Ceres.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never thought of it that way.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Just kidding. Anyway, this is easy. Please wait a moment as I will attempt to decode it.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: (When Rosemary places the fragment on the letter, it immediately melts and disappears. An unknown light appears and hovers around the letter, and then invisible writing appears.)

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: That's it. Now, shall we read?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rosemary, please read.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Okay. Let's see. 「Rosemary, and %s… . If you are reading this letter, the two of you are probably meeting.”

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: “I am now passing through the North Sea and Deborah region and heading toward Avalon in the dark kingdom of Deimos.”

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Wait… . This human… , where is it?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I'll keep reading.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: “Rosemary, isn’t this person crazy about me? “You’re going to react like this.”

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Of course. Are you crazy? Where are you now, alone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happens next?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Wait a minute. I'll calm down a bit. Phew… .Let’s continue.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: “I’m curious about something. Don't worry too much because you'll be in and out quickly. Because there is something I must do for this continent and the Goddess Iris.”

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: As expected, Frozen is arbitrary… .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: 「%s, I heard that you are meeting superhumans. If we do that, we will be able to reduce the danger to the world coming here.”

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: That person seems to know about you too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since he is a great demigod, it is only natural that you know him.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: “I’m sorry. I thought Velosh had solved the problem, but it suddenly went wrong... . Something happened to him. “It’s a pity that I can’t explain it at length.”

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: “Even if you are a Demigod who has been given some of the power of God, there are things you can do and things you cannot do… . “At that time, he was so conceited that he couldn’t tell the difference.”

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: “Neither I nor Lydia knew.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Velosh, Frozen, Lydia... . Are they demigods from the Temple of Ceres?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: None of these three people have real names. Everyone calls it that, so I just call it that too.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Then I'll read it to you later.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: “I’ll prepare a place soon…” . I also want to meet the goddess. And to my beloved Rosemary. Don't worry about me. “Don’t react too harshly to these words again.”

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Who, who reacts violently!!

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: (With those words, Frozen's letter is torn into pieces in Rosemary's hands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well then, I'll go to Luman now. Thank you for your letter, Rosemary.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Ah, you. You said you were going to Lu Men, right?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Then, I would like you to pass on the contents of the letter to Priest Miya. Miya is recording some of the Demigods' activities.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Well then, Rosemary, take care too.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Okay, bye.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: (Hmm. I’m not sure, but what’s certain is that the Deimos Church is plotting something… No way?! Oh, no, right?)

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: (Besides, the sanctuary is quiet these days. The ignorant sabers will take care of it, but...)

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: May God be with you always... . Ah, you are Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came here because of Rosemary’s request.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Yes, let me listen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Priest Miya that a letter from Demigod Frozen has arrived.)

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: I see. Adventurer, you don’t have to worry too much.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Even if there is a big problem, since you are Frozen, you will quickly resolve it and come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Adventurer, I hope you take care of yourself when you work in the future.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: We would like to give a helpful title to Adventurer in our denomination. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I like it. Well then thank you… .

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: This is a title proposed by Melvik in Tartarus and passed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Are you Melvik? If Mr. Melvik suggested it... .

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: I think it’s a title that suits Adventurer well. Then may God bless you Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, wait a minute!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goddess's motherfucker %s, isn't it strange!! What on earth does the church think of me?!
